bluf: Goodway Group is an independent US media agency founded 1929 that now sells itself as a commerce media partner for retail and CPG brands, leading with retail media and incrementality measurement. The record shows Publix appointing it to connect its commerce system and Unleashed Brands moving a franchise portfolio to outcome based media, both undated. Its own house passes every test the Radar ran, yet its sitemap shows nothing updated in 90 days. A rival should know the Horus read is Neutral at 7.7, most exposed to the price of attention splitting, and the Monsoon read is Doldrums: this book does not buy on price.
doing:
The positioning line reads: independent commerce focused media partner for retail and CPG brands, combining Commerce, Connection and Consulting to tie digital spend to store sales. In plain words: a media buyer that sells retail media and measurement to brands that sell through grocers and mass retailers, . The headline claim is awards plus a name: retail media award winner (AdExchanger, Digiday, Modern Retail) appointed by Publix to connect its commerce system.

The sold mix is Commerce, Connections and Consultancy, with named offers from Commerce Media Sophistication Assessment and RMN Campaign Management to Retail Data Monetization, Incrementality Measurement and a Self-Service DSP. Retail Media is the sole lead line at 3: the H1 and meta lead with Connected Commerce for retail and CPG, a Walmart Connect offer, and the Stella Rosa Walmart case. Core lines at 2 are Data & Measurement (incrementality as a Commerce service; the Stella Rosa exposed versus control lift; propensity model cases), Local (a Multi-Location audience in the nav; franchise work with Unleashed Brands), Paid Search (Anytime Fitness leads, hyperlocal SEM), Paid Social (Meta and TikTok cases including a QSR TikTok alpha test) and Programmatic & CTV (the Self-Service DSP; programmatic video and audio cases). Proprietary names: Connected Commerce OS, GOES and the Self-Service DSP.

The AI posture is split: it runs a Connected Commerce OS powered by GOES and agentic AI, while CEO Paul Frampton-Calero and the news feed take a skeptical line on agentic advertising hype; AI Automation scores 1 and AI Search / GEO 0.

Moves: in 2025 it was named in Chief Marketer's Top 50 Campaigns of the Year; two moves carry no date, the Publix appointment and the Unleashed Brands partnership on outcome based media. The record lists no pricing model, headcount, offices or jobs. Conspicuously absent for a commerce shop: SEO, web, email and CRM, CRO and content all at 0, and no marketplace partner beyond Walmart Connect.
clients:
The Radar files the client type as enterprise, the home market as the US, and the verticals as CPG, Grocery & retail, Beverage alcohol, QSR, Automotive, Healthcare, Fitness & franchises, Financial services, Sports & entertainment, Agriculture, Travel and B2B technology. The needs read counts 11 clients: 6 observed, 5 named only.

The observed needs: Stella Rosa came for commerce and marketplaces (case study: connected commerce incremental impact); DGMN for paid performance (boosting roas with real time insights); Left Hand Agency, an agency client, for paid performance and commerce (from linear tv to retail media); Trellix for brand and creative (slug: launching the latest leading enterprise cybersecurity brand). Two reads sit oddly against the notes: the needs read files Anytime Fitness under organic demand (slug: rebounds through search) though the Paid Search note describes leads and hyperlocal SEM, and Subaru retailers under web build (slug: amplifying conversion rates with audio) though the Programmatic note describes an audio campaign. Publix and Unleashed Brands are press release names only, Strategic America (an agency client), Kubota and Fleet Feet slugs only, so their needs are inferred from the sold mix, retail media and measurement.

The mix read is paid performance at 0.323, commerce at 0.242, organic demand and web build at 0.161 each, brand at 0.113. One client is shared: Anytime Fitness sits on the wpromote book. Five of the 11 are names only.

What the base needs next: KJ9 (measurement gets worse before it gets better) is its tailwind, so it is likely, with moderate confidence, that its CPG and grocery clients keep buying incrementality and clean measurement; KJ7 (local discovery is being enclosed) is a headwind, so it is a roughly even chance the franchise accounts ask for LSA and Sponsored Places work the record does not show.
house: Say and do: 3 of 3 tested lines are practised on its own house. Paid search is corroborated: it runs its own Google ads, 2 in the Transparency Center and 2 in the last 30 days, last shown 27 September 2026. Paid social is corroborated by a LinkedIn Insight pixel on its site. LinkedIn advertising is corroborated: 24 company page ads on the first results page, from 61 ads matching the name query, with more pages, so 24+ is a floor. One sample reads that it supported a leading CPG brand in generating 4X incremental sales and 20.58X ROAS through Walmart. The record flags no gaps, yet content velocity is the weak point: a sitemap of 416 URLs with 0 updated in 90 days and 151 in 365. No llms.txt; no AI crawler blocked. The tag stack is GA4, LinkedIn Insight, Pardot, Hotjar and OneTrust on Webflow; no test tools or ABM stack are listed.
market:
The Horus read scores a tailwind index of 7.7, Neutral band. It is best placed for KJ9 (measurement gets worse before it gets better, net 0.219), driven by Data & Measurement, and for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) through Paid Search. It is most exposed to KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two, net -0.169) through Paid Social and Programmatic & CTV, and to KJ7 (local discovery is being enclosed) through Local. Best fit is The Walled Oasis at 50/100. The read has it making P4, partial on P2 (feed or entity work, not a named line) and P3 (local at depth, no LSA work), unknown on P5, and absent on P1, P6, P7 and P8.

The Monsoon read scores 39.5, Doldrums band: migration 42.0 against displacement 37.0, with Local (11) and Paid Search (8) carrying the most movable hours. The work would go 65% to South and Southeast Asia and 25% to Latin America. No hub office and no onshore claim are listed, footprint inferred; the enterprise client type counts against displacement.
openings:
The strongest opening is measurement without a price tag. It sells incrementality and outcome based media, yet the record lists no pricing model (P5 unknown), so a public, outcome priced retail media offer forces a conversation it cannot have on its own site; likely, moderate confidence. The falsifier is a published price or outcome guarantee on goodwaygroup.com.

The paid media hours are exposed: KJ5 runs through paid social and programmatic, the lines its cases lean on, and no ads are tested inside AI assistants (P8 absent). A rival showing assistant ad results with holdouts to its QSR and beverage clients likely sets the price; moderate confidence.

The local book is contestable: it sells local at depth (Multi-Location, Unleashed Brands) but shows no LSA or Sponsored Places work (P3 partial) while KJ7 encloses local discovery; an agency with that work wins the franchise accounts; Anytime Fitness, shared with wpromote, is already shopping. The idle sitemap (0 updates in 90 days) means a live publishing machine can out cite it on retail media within the edition; very likely, high confidence. The Walmart Connect line is unlikely to be contestable on price: the Doldrums read says this book does not buy on price.
watch: I4, Meta Q3 2026 average price per ad, next reading late October 2026: a print at or above +5% continues walled garden inflation and deepens its KJ5 exposure through paid social and programmatic.

I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, next reading late October 2026: search and other growth below 10% flags cannibalisation of its paid search line; above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1.
I10, Reddit US daily users versus search referral volatility, next reading late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk behind KJ1.

The undated Publix appointment: a dated press release or case study describing scope would turn the headline claim into an observed need and show whether the commerce system work is media, data or both.
The next Radar compile: the dossier is only as fresh as 28 September 2026, and a new compile refreshes offices, ads, sitemap cadence and clients.
